name: Creative Process Scroller
description: Pinned fullscreen scroll section where two columns of words highlight one at a time while background photos wipe in, a featured title animates, and a closing text block follows.
contents: Header title lines over fullscreen background images
Left and right word columns with a centered featured title
Closing section with title and paragraph
behavior: Section is pinned and each scroll step snaps to the next item
Background images reveal by clip-path wipe with parallax shift
Featured title animates word by word
Clicking a word jumps to its section
Layout blurs and shrinks as the closing section arrives
Columns stack on screens 768px and below
